parameters.name: AcceptLanguage
parameters.description:
The language of the response. Valid values:

- zh-CN: Chinese

- en-US (default): English

parameters.name: Address
parameters.description: The updated IP address or domain name.

parameters.name: AddressId
parameters.description: The unique ID of the address.

parameters.name: AttributeInfo
parameters.description: The attribution information of the address.

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: A client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can specify a custom value for this parameter, but you must make sure that the value is unique among different requests. The value can contain a maximum of 64 ASCII characters.

parameters.name: HealthJudgement
parameters.description:
The updated condition for determining the health status of the address:

- any\_ok: At least one probe is normal for all health check templates.

- p30\_ok: At least 30% of the probes are normal for all health check templates.

- p50\_ok: At least 50% of the probes are normal for all health check templates.

- p70\_ok: At least 70% of the probes are normal for all health check templates.

- all\_ok: All probes are normal for all health check templates.

parameters.name: HealthTasks
parameters.description: The list of health check tasks.

sub_parameters.name: Port
sub_parameters.description:
The service port of the target address for the health check. You cannot configure a service port if the health check uses the ping protocol.

- If you leave this parameter empty, the currently configured port is deleted.

- If you specify a value for this parameter, the port is updated to the specified value.

sub_parameters.name: TemplateId
sub_parameters.description:
The ID of the health check template associated with the address. This parameter is required if you configure a health check port.

- If you leave this parameter empty, the currently configured health check template is deleted.

- If you specify a value for this parameter, the health check template is updated to the specified value.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The updated name of the address.
